blocks.text: Kuleshov cut the same neutral shot of an actor's face against three
different images — soup, a coffin, a woman — and audiences praised his
range. Hunger, grief, desire. Same frame every time.
The meaning was not in the face. It was in the gap between the shots, and
the audience put it there themselves. **Nothing on screen contains the

feeling.**

I have been reading about this for a week and I cannot let go of it.
